tokens.name: sequoia
tokens.usage: Brand red, the primary brand colour (Pantone 484 C). Dome, shapes, icon fills, headline accents. Text-safe on `snow` and `white` (8.4:1); never as text on `black-oak` (2.1:1). Print: RGB 142 28 2, CMYK 27 98 100 33.

tokens.name: camas
tokens.usage: Brand purple (Pantone 522 C). Dome, shapes and icon fills, soft panels. Not a text colour on light grounds (2.2:1 on `snow`); reads well as text on `black-oak` (8.2:1). Print: RGB 176 163 208, CMYK 37 39 0 0.

tokens.name: white-fir
tokens.usage: Brand gold, called "fir" or "green" in file names (Pantone 458 C). Dome, shapes and icon fills, highlights on dark. Never as text on light grounds (1.6:1 on `snow`); text-safe on `black-oak` (11:1). Print: RGB 210 198 99, CMYK 22 15 71 2.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Brand off-white. Slide and presentation backgrounds, the light logo ink, reversed text on `sequoia` and `black-oak`. Print: RGB 247 246 245, CMYK 5 4 5 0.

tokens.name: black-oak
tokens.usage: Brand black. Logo ink, body and headline text, arrows, icon outlines, dark grounds. Print: RGB 15 15 15, CMYK 0 0 0 99.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Page background for documents and web (slides use `snow`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page ground for documents and web.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Slide backgrounds and secondary panels. Dark value is a derived step above `black-oak`, not a brand colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface` and `surface-alt` (17:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footnotes and secondary labels on `surface` and `surface-alt` (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Emphasis text, links and key numbers on `surface`. Sequoia on light, White Fir on dark so it keeps contrast.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks placed on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules and card borders.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline on interactive elements; 3:1 or better on `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (the client or the hero metric). Pair with `chart-2` before adding more.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series or the benchmark / previous period.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. Never place directly beside `chart-4` without a gap or label.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. On light grounds give it a `black-oak` outline or direct label, since it sits at 1.6:1 on `snow`.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis rules.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive change in KPIs. Always paired with an up arrow or a + sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative change in KPIs. Always paired with a down arrow or a minus sign, never colour alone.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The values voice: two or three words, sentence case, always ending in a full stop, set in one brand colour. Cover slides, posters, social tiles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Hero numbers in KPI tiles and chart callouts, in `ink` or `accent`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover slides and hero statements. One per page.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The italic voice of the tagline; a single emphasised word inside a serif line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a heading, in `accent`.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We help ambitious brands reach their whole potential.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and slide body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Spend shifted toward prospecting lifted new customer revenue.
styles.usage: Default running text in documents and web.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Source: Meta Ads Manager, 1 Jul to 30 Sep.
styles.usage: Table cells, notes and secondary copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart labels, captions and footers, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Slide headline, max two lines, top left at the `space-16` margin.

styles.name: slide-subhead
styles.usage: Column and box subheads on slides.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Spend shifted toward prospecting and lifted new customer revenue.
styles.usage: Slide body copy. Never smaller than 20px on a slide.

styles.name: slide-date
styles.usage: The date stamp in DD.MM.YY format that sits on every templated slide, in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush edges, e.g. the dome sitting on the frame edge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside small components.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its paragraph.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense layouts, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between grouped blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between sections inside a page or slide.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide margins and major section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding and generous slide margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Outer margin on 1920 x 1080 slides.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed images and slide edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, image frames and panels; echoes the soft corners on the brand shapes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and pill labels.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Table rules, dividers, card borders (colour `hairline`).

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and focus rings.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: The thick black outline on illustrated icons at 1042px artwork size; mirror it (about 0.6% of width) when drawing companion diagrams.

shadow.note: The brand uses no drop shadows. Separate with space, a hairline or a flat fill.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for every surface.
